description: Shared view and request shapes for the dev.antiphony.audio.* methods. These are READ-TIME and REQUEST-TIME shapes, not records: nothing here is stored or enters a record CID. The stored contract is dev.antiphony.audio.post. Mirrors the Zod schemas in @antiphony/shared (types/audio.ts, types/processing.ts, api-codecs.ts), which the lexicon-parity oracle holds to these definitions.

postView.description: The hydrated, client-facing shape of a post — the app.bsky.feed.defs#postView analogue. Record content plus opaque author references, a hydrated embed, and per-viewer state. Author identity is carried as REFERENCES, never a hydrated profile: Antiphony holds no user data, so the calling app joins on `authorId` to render a display identity.

uri.description: The post's at:// URI. Its authority is the tenant app's DID, not the end user's.

cid.description: Content CID of the canonical record, computed over the lexicon projection only (no storage or tenancy fields), so a StrongRef built from it is a verifiable content address.

kind.description: Denormalized from `reply` presence on the record: `reply` set ⇒ `reply`, absent ⇒ `prompt`. A convenience for clients, not a second source of truth.

authorId.description: The authoring actor's app-scoped id — an opaque attribution reference, not a profile and not an AT Protocol identity.

authorDid.description: The author's AT Protocol DID, present only when the calling app asserted one it had itself verified.

record.description: The public lexicon fields of the post.

embed.description: The hydrated attachment — a resolved playback URL plus the transcript lifted from the enrichment record. Absent when the post carries no audio.

viewer.description: The requesting viewer's relationship to this post.

postRecord.description: The public projection of a post record as it appears on a view: the lexicon fields only. The stored record additionally carries storage-layer facets (tenancy, author, processing state) that are deliberately absent here and from the record CID.

text.description: USER-authored text. May be empty for a pure-audio post. NEVER the transcript.

title.description: Optional headline. A prompt feature; replies carry none.

reply.description: Present iff this post is a reply. Presence is the prompt/reply discriminator.

langs.description: BCP-47 language tags for the post text.

selfLabels.description: Author-applied self-label VALUES. A flattening of the record's com.atproto.label.defs#selfLabels: the view carries the bare strings, since a client rendering a content warning needs the value and nothing else.

viewerState.description: The requesting viewer's relationship to a post — the app.bsky #viewerState pattern. Computed per read from the caller's asserted acting actor; lives on the view and never on the record. An anonymous (viewer-less) read gets `isAuthor: false, canReply: false`.

isAuthor.description: Whether the acting actor authored this post.

canReply.description: Whether the acting actor may reply. A prompt is repliable by any authenticated viewer; a reply only by its branch participants.

replyDisabledReason.description: Why `canReply` is false. Omitted when the viewer can reply.

processingRequest.description: An opt-in request for asynchronous audio processing. Every stage is off by default; only `true` asks for work. A stage this deployment has no provider for settles as `skipped` on the view rather than failing the request.

trim.description: Leading/trailing silence removal. Byte-mutating; runs after denoise.

transcribe.description: Machine transcription. Derived — analysis over the final audio variant.

reprocess.description: Whether a completed byte-mutating stage invalidates and recomputes the derived artifacts describing the superseded audio. Defaults to true — a transcript of replaced audio is wrong, not merely stale. Names no stage, so a request carrying only this asks for no work.
